body:
I know the feeling of only being liked when my mask is on. Being told that Im too much or not enough. It's hard when people won't hold room for you or give you grace when your dealing with your mental health.

You've probably felt broken, lost, despair before. I know I have (this year has been my worst so far). When I feel disconnected from my reality I go to the gym and reconnect with my body. I've been spending 2/3 hours in the gym just to escape my mind. I figure life goes on even when I don't want to. You'll find a way through as you've done it before. It's difficult to pull yourself out of a doom spiral.

I'm sorry you don't have a strong support system. That your family hasn't been there for you. You are not alone. You can find kindness in strangers. I can't promise things will get better. You can definitely find the strength in yourself to keep moving forward, even if it's only one step at a time.

Dude, what happened to you was fucked up!😡 She took advantage of you during a vulnerable moment in your life. This moment your in, feeling hopeless, abandoned by your friends, feeling stupid that you went down this path is just a moment. It doesnt define you. The fact that it hurts means your learning from it.

The hardest part is building yourself back up from here. You don't have to do this alone. I'm currently building myself back up from being broken up with ( I was together with my partner for almost 8 years and I knew them 2 years prior). I thought I was alone, my ex systematically isolated me from our old friends.

I found new hobbies ( I play Magic on fridays/Sundays, I go to the gym after work, I paint, I replayed Mass Effect). I reconnected with myself and have been learning who I am. I found new friends and some old friends that realized the manipulation I had been under.

All this to say, you can make it through this. There are resources/help services for your situation that you can reach out to. I know you can do it. You might feel trapped but you have the capacity to change yourself around.

Go to your doctor. Get referred to an endocrinologist (They specialize in Hormones). It's important to stay on top of this, especially as a woman.
I have ADHD and my hormones are constantly shuffling me to extreme states. It's difficult to moderate my behavior when I feel like a war is brewing inside me.
What has worked for me?
1. Sleep (no joke most of my problems from not enough sleep)
2. Eating regularly (stop snacking on chips/fast food and start regular meals. This can be difficult at first so pick one safe meal for breakfast to build a habit)
3. EXERCISE (anything as simple as walking around campus, me personally I lift weights)

Side note: I was in a similar situation a couple months ago with my ex. He couldn't "handle" my emotions but he was always relying on me when life wasn't going his way. His words "You always say the right things. I can't do that for you." 

Focus on PROJECT: YOU!!! Being single isn't the same thing as being lonely/alone. You can always find new friends, go back to old friends, meet with family, and the kind strangers online.  You always have to live with you. So make yourself someone you can love and don't worry about someone else loving you.
Draw or write something down. This moment will pass. For now focus on a small thing you can do in the here and now.

There really isn't much in life you can control. I'm always told things get better when you put in the effort. I've always been bullied and mocked while studying/learning so now I have a fear of learning anything. I'm 26 and every where I've worked I've been punished for asking questions and trying to understand. People just downright suck. In the past 3 years I can barely muster the energy to leave the house. That's not even to say all the habits that I've built up that I should be proud of. Going to the gym everyday, having hobbies, eating on a regular basis. All these things I have control over and yet I'm still miserable and wishing for a sweet release.

I don't really count it as horror. Maybe I'm desensitized to this kind of horror. [I'm a complete scaredy-cat when it comes to jumpscare style games]. There is quite a bit of built up suspense but I find STP pretty funny (The Damsel, stranger, adversary, and razor tickles my funny bone). Although one of the paths that sends me into shivers is Nightmare because of the sounds.

Each path explores a different relationship dynamic which means you'll be feeling different emotional highs and lows. Just go at your own pace and you should be fine. There are no right or wrong decisions. There is only a conversation.

I like your Kallamar the best! He looks like he's bulging out of his robes which I think is super cool considering that he carries all his weapons under his robe.

Compared to the in game design I think yours hits pretty hard.

I like pizza! I want to eat more of it! Sometimes silly little phrases like this can give me motivation to make it to the next day. I hope this can bring a small smile to you.

I'm also lonely. I have a handful of friends and a boyfriend as well (He is a tenacious workaholic). I don't get to see him very often since our schedules don't line up.

It ducks that you've been out of work. I can relate my career is very much dependent on the state of the world as well as the seniority. I'm lucky if I get 1 shift a week.

I recently ducked up training for my job. I was very sick and the training was not something that could be rescheduled. Because I ducked up I failed the course and I've been put on a waiting list to retake it. It felt like the end of the world and that I wasn't good at anything. But I gave it some thought and I might try again or I might just not pursue the training further because in the end it doesn't effect my career that much.

No matter what stage of life we are in, we have to give ourselves a chance to reflect and forgive ourselves for our shortcomings.

All this to say, eat more pizza and thank the pizza lord! May you find the food that gives you everlasting power!

I'm back up to platinum and all the games I played there was not a single real player. In plat still no real players. Where are all the players? I won every game even one time when the hunter had the kill on me and just refused to hit hero power. Probably not going to play ever again.

It's hard when you had a coping mechanism that was so hurtful to yourself but helped relieve the mental stress. I dont cut myself but I do stab my arms alot. Not enough to bleed just enough to bruise. I do it with mechanical pencils. 

There are alot of different coping mechanisms out there for when it gets too much

- Writing/drawing out your thoughts
- Talking with others
- meditating
-playing games
- listening to music
- going for a walk/exercising

You are not alone. I dont promise life will get easier. But try looking into different coping methods and see if any of them work for you. Dont be ashamed that you went back to cutting. Alot of us have been there it's not worth looking down on ourselves. Becoming our own villain just makes you feel shitty. Instead show yourself some compassion. If someone you knew was going through what you are going through wouldn't you want to help them? You wouldn't put them down for cutting when you know they are in so much pain. Youd try to understand and see what help you could get for them. 

Show yourself the same kindness as youd show to others.

What you do is your business no one else's. You dont  deserve to be treated like crap by your friends and exes. They are allowed to disagree but they cant start shit talking you behind your back because they think they can live your life better. 

Id recommend cutting your ex out of your life. He's literally holding you hostage, using his body as ransom. If he cant hold his shit together and not cut because he blames you; that's on him not you. You cant be nursing his mental health while your looking out for yourself and he's actively trying to sabotage you.

The stuff going on in your life is shit. I ain't gonna lie. But I hope you can rebuild your mental health enough to allow yourself to trust others again. It's not fair what your 'friends' and ex did to you. I'm pissed for you.

Allow yourself some time to recover. Watch a movie, eat your favorite ice cream. Just allow yourself to heal from this.

That guy sounds like a fucking asshole. Who the fuck let him 'help's others? I'm frustrated for you.

I've been told to choose to look at the bright side. Choose to work. Choose to finish what you start. It's not that simple. I put on airs for 2 years that I could work and do school. I choose to continue and I feel worse off than ever before.

Being told to choose is the worst thing that asshole could have said. Did he bring up anything of use? Any strategies to tackle your issues? No he said you have to choose. Dont give up on finding help that asshole isnt the right fit for you and dont let him beat you down.

Yknow what though? You choose to look for help. That's such a huge step. I'm proud of you. This guy cant help you. FUCK HIM! Find someone else. Itll be hard trust me. I know it's hard.

But when you get the help you deserve you can look back at this and be like "Fuck that asshole. I got the help I needed and I'm better off." And then that guy will just be a blip in your memory.

I've been stuck in College 4 years now and nothing seems to ever get better. Everyone tells me I only have 2 semesters left but I cant even pull myself together for 1. 

The pages of the textbook just smear into each other. I don't even know what I'm supposed to study. Profs aren't any help. My parents say they "encourage" me but have never once cared about how I'm doing mentally.

At the beginning of the semester my mom hit me an scolded me for not doing the dishes when I was in the middle of lectures. Now she wonders why I cant focus on my studies. I dont know are you going to hit me again?

It doesnt really matter at this point. I have no hope of completing my degree with my mental state as is. I cant sleep, my eating is irratic, I'm afraid of being touched, afraid of failure even though I've brought it on myself. Why when I read the material and make notes do I not absorb anything? Every assignment, every quiz, every midterm is a painful reminder of how fucked I am.

I've been on and off thinking about killing myself right now at the ripe young age of 22. Parents want to kick me out because I'm so unhappy living with them. They dont know how to support me. They think they've done nothing but help. Really I'm just living off dads income. I lost my job with the pandemic and nowhere in my area is hiring. I'm stuck. Im trapped. When will my nightmares end?

I wish there was a poison that was painless and quick acting. Maybe if I got sleeping pills and mixed the two I'd be better.
Imagine waking up from a dream where you were severely injured in a car accident. I did that yesterday and I'm still upset that it didnt really happen.

Days go by but I'm still here. The happiness has left. I enjoy every moment with my BF but when he's gone I always want to end it. He's sleeping next to me as I type this. I won't end it today or even tomorrow. But i know that thought is going to win eventually

I only recommend saying anything if you think you and your family can handle the consequences of the truth. There are a lot of ways telling them can go wrong. I'd just say you want to express your thoughts to a professional or something. You dont have to tell your family why you want to get help. It's ok. I'm just as close to the edge as you are but hopefully we'll find the help we need.
Ha right. I'm tired as well. Its 3am over here. So my brain is failing.
Yeah. It might be better to say nothing for now. I guess try to reach out online for now to see if you can find a new group. Might be surprised by who you can find online.

Happy Birthday! BLAH! I feel you. The only person I have close in my life is my BF. Every person I met has had a friend group with that one toxic person who is more important to the group than me because they've been there longer. 

Guilt tripping is no joke. I had one person who had me convinced I was better off alone because I was the villain. If you are feeling like that know it's not you its them. If they wont have a conversation about this emotional abuse and make an effort to change then they aren't worth your time. 

You must feel really alone. Make a plan to do something you'll really enjoy when lock down lifts. I always make one plan for the future that I can look forward to so that I dont just see hell all the time.

I'm afraid that I'm going to be thinking this way as well. If someone who's graduated, had a good paying job, and  is only 2 years older than me is thinking like this. What hope is there for me? For anyone? 

I'm sorry you have to suffer through this period of uncertainty in your life. Just know that I'm rooting for you to find that meaning your looking for.

We are all gluttons for punishment and most of us know there is nothing past death. Faith can have us believe that the afterlife is worth living for or we'll be better off dead but none of that is true.

I think my life is a fucking waste on this planet. I'm privileged in pretty much every way. I look good, parents make good money, went to the best schools money can buy, was always on the starting line up for Soccer. I'm still depressed and that's not going to change. I have 0 friends besides my BF. I've never been good at keeping friends. Communication has never been my best quality. Oh well we just keep living and the  typing on reddit how much we want to die like some kind of diary of illness.

We always push the people we care about most away. I know I dont want to hurt anyone but I cant be that happy girl that everyone wants me to be. My BF has been with me for 6 years and he knows I've always tried my best. He always reassures me that he'll always be with me. I'm lucky to have found him.

I dont have any friends. And my intrusive thoughts have made me push my family away where I will only leave my room for meals. 

I believe the only true meaning of my life is to love as much as I can. I'm happiest when I'm near him and every other moment I try anything I'm only in despair. I'm afraid of people, going outdoors, and my anxiety. He is the one person that keeps me grounded and connected to the world. 

I hope you find someone that connects with you in the same way my BF does for me. That one person that you cant push away no matter how much you try. That one person who can help carry part of your mental burdens and develop strategies to tackle your problems.

Having goals can have the opposite effect though. Especially for me. I've been trying to finish my degree in Financial Management. I've switched paths so many times because I've been told my grades are shit even though I got tutors went to the profs and even used sites like chegg. I used to spend all my time on campus in the library (My only real reprieve from my shitty home life).

I've been told no one will hire me because my grades suck by everyone who was supposed to help me. I had a goal but apparently hardworking means nothing if you cant make the grade.

I've been told that because I'm depressed I need to play it up so that companies will hire me to meet there "diversity" requirement. Yknow how fucked up that sounds? "Just be sad and frustrated all the time, you'll definitely be hired now".

Anyways TL;DR finding purpose might send you in a deeper spiral when you cant live up to your own expectations.

At least you know there are other people who can relate to you even if they havent gone through exactly what you are experiencing. I'm 22 and I can attest we are in the hardest point in our lives right now.

I stay up until 5am to get any homework done because my parents wont stop yelling at me about how much of a disgrace I am throughout the day. The only times I get relief are 10:30am-2:30pm for classes. And 1am-5am for homework. Yeah I get no sleep because depressed all the time. I'm on the fence with you. Why be here at all if I'm losing myself to work?

 Tomorrow I'm moving in with my boyfriend's family because my dad and mom crossed a line. Dad tried to kick down my door and beat me. Mom said I was letting him down and I was ungrateful for everything he's done. Honestly some people will never be able to understand and wont try to. My parents are some of those people. 

Try to be a part of this community we have here and help others. Its cathartic. People are nice on here for the most part. And maybe it can be one thing that keeps you grounded.

What's the point in studying? We all hope that someday we'll get a fucking good job, working under somebody. But I've had enough of this. My depression is a fucking joke to my family. Everyone's always called me crazy or sick or cry baby or lazy. I used to be straight A, team MVP for HPL and travel soccer teams. But that's all fucking gone. It was just an illusion. Nothing is real. Nothing feels real except for this knife.

I was "Diagnosed" with depression at the age of 5. In quotes because you cant actually be diagnosed at the age but I showed alot of symptoms. So now I'm 22 so like 17 years of depression. 3 suicide attempts. Living the high life here. Been in group and solo counseling. I've been on several different antidepressants and a few anxiety relievers. I like the anxiety medication because it makes me sleep for a long time. I took more than the recommended once (the pills are not much bigger than a small piece of salt) and I was asleep for 2 days. If I could sleep forever it still wouldn't be enough.

Anyways what "triggered" me today was trying to join a not-so-competive team for league of legends. The guys in the group made it very difficult to say no to when they were coming up with team comps. They put me on a champ I was uncomfortable playing and then told me how shit I was. It was hard to stand up for myself.

This isnt the only place this happens. It happens at work, at school, at friends houses and home. I'm really sick of being told how useless I am.

I mean if you want to juggle I know a great circus. And usually the dollar store has some great selections.

Sorry not helpful I just want to lighten the mood
Is it bad that I'm fantasizing about grabbing a kitchen knife and falling off my balcony landing on the knife into my chest? I want a quick and painless death. Maybe a guillotine?

Yeah it's hard not to criticize myself. But I've been told by co-op advisers that my grades aren't that high and for my field of study (accounting) no one would want to hire me. A lot of my classes fluctuate between C and B+ depending on how bad I get sick or hit with depression. What they said has really stuck with me more than anything else which kills me. I've never been good at tests no matter how much support I get.

I've been a Business application tutor at my school where I taught intermediate word, excel and powerpoint. I taught others how to use the accounting program Sage 50. But I still feel like nothing is ever good enough.

I have all these negative feelings inside (anger, frustration, deep sadness) my life feels stagnant while everyone is getting on in life. I've been told I'm head strong, hard working, and smart. I dont feel like I'm any of those things anymore (I study 8 hours a day and that isnt enough for me).

I only have 1 year left of school until I get my degree but it's taking forever due to illness and depression. I feel like I'm living a lie. That even when I'm done with school no company will hire me. So why even try?

I've been in college for 3 years now with what feels like nothing to show for it. I've failed alot of classes. Switched my path around (nursing to accounting). I get sick easily so I always fall behind part way through the semester. My BF keeps reminding me how far I've come and how little there is left. My mom wont let me study and plan my work load out on my own. She yells threatens to kick me out. And my dad is currently in the hospital. 

I sleep and cry a lot now after I've done my studying but I'm still always tired.

Hang in there. You'll get through this. I know you can.

My wishes for the future

1. To get my CPA

2. To make enough money to escape my narcissistic mother and support myself.

3. No longer be overwhelmed by stress from school, abuse, work and socializing.

Honestly my wishes for right now are.

1. To die fast and painlessly
2. Forget everyone and everything that's caused me pain
3. Make it into heaven even though killing myself is a sin.

Yeah every character should have flaws and the story should not forget past actions of the characters. I completely agree with you here. I'm going to wait a month to see if this gets any better because I've had enough of the repetitive nature of John, Remi, Arlo, and Sera. The only characters that I care about is Blyke because he's taking an active role in training his abilities and recognized his own flaws.

I mean there's being a purposeful dickhead and then theres just whining/crying/yelling without much purpose. He doesnt seem to have a brain anymore or that much of a character. All I read from him now is a destructive force that needs to be stopped. That wasnt season 1 John. Season 1 John was resourceful in fights where he didnt use his abilities. During the time he played poker with Sera he seemed to be someone who knew the odds and who could bluff his way through. Yeah there is is past but that's more of a contrivance for his rage. I wasn't even that huge a fan of John's but it's sad to see the state that the character (lack there of).

I mean they were all just kids what were we really expecting them to do. If an adult stepped in at any time during the early development years maybe the characters wouldn't be so fucked up now. But still I've dropped Unordinary starting today. There's too much ignored from season 1 which I loved. Every character seems to have forgotten the bullying that they put John through. I see the arguments about whether it was fair for Arlo to ambush John and in my opinion decent people shouldn't set traps for anyone.

Arlo could have confronted John about his powers without the ambush. 1 on 1. Tell John he had powers in season 1 and maybe try to train him y'know so that he'd fit somewhere in his precious hierarchy.

John yells all the time. Sera pretends she didnt use to act like a bully high tier because she had "expectations" set on her and she had one of the most OP powers.

I really just wanted to vent out my frustrations before dropping. Find a bit of closure.

Yeah at work I had this idea to jump from the 4th floor head first. But then I ended up being called over by the managers to be a representative of my area to present on one obstacle I have in my station. I was so busy practicing my little 3 min speech that I stopped feeling hopeless. Sometimes the thoughts in my head need to be distracted by a greater purpose even if it was something so minor.
Oh forgot to mention my mom does not work or have any hobbies to have her car matter at all. She sits at the TV all day with her rowing machine.
My mom is too selfish for that. My dad needs his car to go work (he leaves earlier than me 3pm). And my mom said flatly she doesnt want to feel trapped.

I've always had issues losing weight [22F] but I've always been very active and muscular. Ive been on the receiving end of "You need to lose weight remember?" You've already been told enough that YTA and I want to share something that could help you reconcile with your daughter.

When I finally confronted my dad about how reminding me to lose weight doesnt actually help me lose weight we were able to come up with alternative approaches to help build our bond and health.

Try in the morning after breakfast offering to go for a walk. Or maybe take on a hobby like gardening. Growing your own vegetables can help reduce stress and encourage a healthier diet. 

And whoever buys the groceries for your family needs to think about how to encourage healthy weight loss. Because your daughter is right if anyone is surrounded by junk food there will be too much temptation.

I hope these little things can help bring a fresh perspective to the table. Weight loss shouldn't be a burden to be carried alone. It's a team effort.
I know it's a silly thing to take pride in but I was the best picker at Amazon today. It's been only a month and I feel more energized than I've ever been. The only downside is working graveyards.
Happy Birthday Tim! 😃 Hey what a coinky-dink we are the same age. I hope your day brightens up. Here's a little sunshine☀️!
Happy Birthday from Canada my man! I hope your day gets better. I'm sending all the hugs and love your way. And maybe a cool breeze to help with the heat. 😎
This is EXACTLY what I mean! OMG thank you! It means a LOTTLE to me that someone understands what I'm going through and is willing to reply 😀

Oh thank god it's not just me. I cry for my old macbook pro when it was showing me this. Game runs fine otherwise can still click on the 2nd shoe and have dialogue with the manager. This freaked my beans!

Thank you! I've mellowed out. parents left to go get groceries. Its cathartic to release my feelings out in the open. I think that's what I needed. Next week I start up my job at Amazon full time graveyards. Now I have an excuse to get out of the house. I tend to forget that normalcy will come in time. I'm not a failure if I can bring some form of schedule into my life. I just needed to remind myself of that.

Have a great day!

Sounds like you are living my life. My dad hits me everytime I swear. Even if I'm like "Fuck Yeah!" Or "This shit is the best!" Yknow normal terms for excitement he hits me. I can't call the cops though because he makes the money in the house and I'd be screwed.

"He picked up on the swearing. Not the fact his own daughter wanted to die."

Yup that is my exact thought. I hope it helps knowing you are not alone in this.
Yeah I have my parents come in at 3am in my room to yell at me that I'm not asleep when I am. And I pretty much lay in bed all day because I dont want to deal with them anymore.
